n.name: "Brinewake"
n.description: "A stormy island chain."

n.name: "Vesper"
n.description: "Brinewake\'s main port city, built around a tidal lighthouse."

n.name: "Vesper lighthouse"
n.description: "The tidal lighthouse around which Vesper is built. Its lenses run on blue salt and it is maintained by the Lantern Guild."

n.name: "Lantern Guild"
n.description: "Maintains Vesper\'s tidal lighthouse and buys blue salt from Orin\'s miners. It does not own the mines. During winter, when the strait freezes, the guild uses stored salt. The guild opposes the toll on blue salt shipments imposed in 319."

n.name: "Blue salt"
n.description: "Salt used to power the lenses of Vesper\'s lighthouse; mined on the island of Orin."

n.name: "Orin"
n.description: "An island where blue salt is mined by its miners."

n.name: "Orin\'s miners"
n.description: "Miners on Orin who mine blue salt; the Lantern Guild buys salt from them. They formed the Deep Bell Union."

n.name: "Orin\'s mines"
n.description: "Mines on the island of Orin. The Lantern Guild does not own them; it buys blue salt from Orin\'s miners."

n.name: "Asha Pell"
n.description: "Asha Pell was born on Orin and moved to Vesper at age six, where she grew up. She captains the courier ship Nightjar and belongs to the Lantern Guild; her crew usually calls her Captain Ash. She has a small brass key sewn inside her left coat cuff; only her navigator, Iven Marr, knows she has it."

n.name: "Nightjar"
n.description: "A courier ship captained by Asha Pell. Its former April-to-September blue-salt route from Orin to Vesper is retired; it now carries letters from Vesper to Kest, a southern island."

n.name: "Bren Vale"
n.description: "Bren Vale captains the fishing boat Petrel. People on the dock also call him Captain. He is unrelated to Asha Pell and is not a member of the Lantern Guild; he refuses to join because he distrusts Tal Ren\'s friends. He supports the toll on blue salt shipments imposed in 319 because its revenue will repair fishing piers. Nessa is his older sister and the Petrel\'s cook, not his employee on a formal wage."

n.name: "Petrel"
n.description: "A fishing boat captained by Bren Vale, with his older sister Nessa as its cook. Nessa keeps a black cat called Button aboard."

n.name: "Small brass key"
n.description: "A small brass key sewn inside Asha Pell\'s left coat cuff. It opens the old lens room beneath Vesper\'s lighthouse."

n.name: "Old lens room"
n.description: "A room beneath Vesper\'s lighthouse, opened by Asha Pell\'s small brass key. It was permanently sealed by a rockfall in 318; nobody has reopened it, and it has no other entrance."

n.name: "Iven Marr"
n.description: "Asha Pell\'s navigator and the only person who knows she has a small brass key sewn inside her left coat cuff. He lost his right eye in the winter storm of 312. He navigates the Nightjar using tide charts, not magic."

n.name: "the strait"
n.description: "Freezes during winter."

n.name: "Deep Bell Union"
n.description: "A union formed by Orin\'s miners."

n.name: "Sera Dain"
n.description: "Leader of the Deep Bell Union. She refuses to sell salt to the military but honors civilian contracts with the Lantern Guild."

n.name: "Tal Ren"
n.description: "Governor of Vesper; imposed a toll on blue salt shipments in 319."

n.name: "Blue salt shipment toll"
n.description: "A toll on blue salt shipments imposed in 319 by Vesper\'s governor, Tal Ren. Its revenue is intended to repair fishing piers. The Lantern Guild opposes it; Bren Vale supports it because the revenue repairs fishing piers."

n.description: Null
n.existing_value: "\"The old lens room was permanently sealed by a rockfall in 318; nobody has reopened it, and it has no other entrance.\""
n.new_value: "\"In 320, Iven meets Sera inside the old lens room to negotiate a salt contract.\""

n.name: Null
n.description: Null
n.existing_value: "\"Asha trusts Iven with routes but does not let him negotiate contracts.\""
n.new_value: "\"In 320, Iven meets Sera inside the old lens room to negotiate a salt contract.\""
n.explanation: "The writer supplied both claims as notes but explicitly has not decided how to reconcile them. Negotiating a salt contract conflicts with the established restriction that Asha does not let Iven negotiate contracts."

n.name: "Nessa"
n.description: "Nessa is Bren Vale\'s older sister and the cook aboard the fishing boat Petrel. She is not Bren\'s employee on a formal wage. She keeps a black cat called Button aboard."

n.name: "Button"
n.description: "A black cat kept by Nessa aboard the fishing boat Petrel."

n.name: "Kest"
n.description: "A southern island."
